scenes.title: Your 2026 Coverage Review
scenes.narration: Hi Morales family. Here is your 2026 coverage review, in under a minute.

scenes.title: Your premium went down
scenes.narration: Good news first. Your monthly premium went down, to eighty-four fifty a month.

scenes.title: What you are covered for
scenes.narration: You keep five hundred thousand dollars of cover for twenty years, and a critical illness rider is now included.

scenes.title: Why it matters
scenes.narration: If the worst happens, the mortgage is paid off and the children's education is funded.

scenes.title: What happens next
scenes.narration: Book a twenty-minute call with me and we will go through it together. Talk soon.
